hints.title: Symmetry Property
hints.text: Due to bilateral symmetry, reaching target is equivalent to reaching absolute value of target.

hints.title: Cumulative Sum Overshoot
hints.text: Find the smallest step count k such that the sum 1 + 2 + ... + k is greater than or equal to target.

hints.title: Even Difference Invariant
hints.text: Flipping a step i from positive to negative reduces the sum by 2 times i (an even amount). Thus sum minus target must be even. If odd, continue adding steps k until the difference becomes even.

hints.title: See the blueprint
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def reachNumber(self, target: int) -> int:
        target = abs(target)
        k = 0
        total = 0
        while total < target or (total - target) % 2 != 0:
            k += 1
            total += k
        return k
```

complexity.notes: Triangular number growth with parity difference check.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: BFS state branching branches exponentially by 2^k steps.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Mathematical accumulation solves the position reachability in O(sqrt(T)) steps and O(1) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Explain why flipping any step i from +i to -i changes the total sum by an even quantity 2*i.
